feeds.title: Rural Mom
feeds.description: Louisville Kentucky Blogger empowering moms seeking creative ideas, adventure, farm fresh recipes and moments of joy. Rural Mom helps deliver hand-picked tools and information to help moms live country life to the fullest. We focus on food, home and gardening, family (including our fur-family!), community, and travel.

feeds.title: Feel Pretty with Pri
feeds.description: I'm Priyanka, a beauty and lifestyle digital creator celebrating inclusivity and empowering you to prioritize your well-being through acts of self care. In this digital corner, not only will you find your new favorite way to self care, but you will also find skincare tips, makeup swatches, and product recommendations that are geared towards sensitive, combination, and medium skin with golden undertones.

feeds.title: Gathered Living
feeds.description: I'm Emily, a lifestyle blogger at Gathered Living and owner of The Amsden in Versailles KY. On my blog, you will find a little bit of everything including our home, recipes, DIY's, happenings at the Amsden, design projects, and more.

feeds.title: Bowling Green Kentucky Blog
feeds.description: Bowling Green, KY offers a great blend of outdoor activities, car festivals, races, great places to eat, and general southern hospitality.

feeds.title: Absolutely Alli
feeds.description: Absolutely Alli is a life and style blog by Allison who has been an influencer and content creator for over 6 years.

feeds.title: JCP Eats
feeds.description: JC is a consultant by day and a Louisville, Kentucky-based blogger by night. Here at JCP Eats, my southern food and lifestyle blog, you'll learn about top restaurants, delicious recipes, and the best way to live life below the Mason-Dixon.

feeds.title: Kentucky Girl Ramblings
feeds.description: I'm Courtney, a thirty-something Kentucky girl with a passion for writing. Kentucky Girl Ramblings is a lifestyle blog focusing on cruelty free beauty and affordable fashion.

feeds.title: Kentucky Taste Buds Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Kentucky Taste Buds, a collaborative effort between two best 'buds' who are committed to 'tasting' all that the beautiful Bluegrass State has to offer from its delectable food, Southern-inspired fashion, craft brews, and world-class bourbon, and the many events offered year-round.

feeds.title: Authentically Emmie Blog
feeds.description: Emily Ho writes about mental health, eating disorders, and family dynamics in today's society. Also shares fun lifestyle things like plus size fashion, personal style, marriage, travel, and home decor.

feeds.title: A Southern Drawl
feeds.description: I'm Grace White! A 27-year-old, currently residing in Louisville, Kentucky with my hubby, Jordan, and our pup, Jeter. At Southern Drawl, you can expect a daily dose of inspiration with outfits, health & wellness tips, travel guides, and more.

feeds.title: The Kentucky Gent
feeds.description: Hey, my name is Josh Johnson. The Kentucky Gent started as a way for me to show that Southern boys have style too. Since the site's inception, it has expanded into a fully fledged men's life and style blog. Consider it the worldwide web's Gateway to the South where I share my passions for fashion, food, grooming, and travel.

feeds.title: Glitter & Gingham Blog
feeds.description: I'm Shelby. G&G is a southern life & style blog based in Lexington, KY where I share my latest outfit obsessions, current beauty favorites, my travel tidbits & everything in between.

feeds.title: Lows to Luxe
feeds.description: Lows to Luxe is a fashion & lifestyle blog all about mixing luxury items with everyday pieces, written by Shaheen Khan. Find everything from fashion & style to recipes, beauty, travel, motherhood & interior design!

feeds.title: Lou What Wear
feeds.description: I'm Danielle. If you're wondering what the 'Lou' stands for it's a shoutout to Louisville, Kentucky. Lou What Wear is an outlet to showcase personal style - both mine and others as well as style inspiration, home decor, beauty and whatever else catches my eye. Most importantly, all of this is done with a focus on life and style in Louisville, Kentucky.

feeds.title: Lipstick Latitude
feeds.description: I'm Nikki, a blogger, IT professional, photographer living, traveller, makeup enthusiast, tattoo collector, low-key foodie, yoga lover, and dog snuggler. I started this blog as a way to share my love of all things beauty-related. Over the years I've learned that my favourite thing about blogging is I love sharing all the details that will help people find what's right for them.

feeds.title: Lex Eats
feeds.description: I'm Leela, a Kentuckian food-lover and blogger. Born and raised in the Bluegrass. I love to share food recipes, lifestyle, and local content through my blog.

feeds.title: Space, Place & Southern Grace
feeds.description: I'm Sarah Caton Walters, author, and founder of Space, Place and Southern Grace. I'm an event planner turned blogger, author, & brand strategist that loves celebrating the work of women. I'm a fervent feminist and am passionate about professionalism. My blog is a platform for me to showcase my creativity, my notion of budget style, and life adventures.

feeds.title: Maddie Duff OTTEstyle
feeds.description: I'm Maddie. OTTEstyle is the perfect match between my strong southern roots and my passion for street style. It is both style and quality driven and focuses on how to take your everyday outfit up a notch. Whether it's adding an edgy leather jacket or timeless statement bag, there is always a way to make any outfit your own and OTTEstyle strives to help you think outside the fashion box.

feeds.title: Avery Walts
feeds.description: I'm Avery Walts - a Louisville-based lifestyle blogger. I call Louisville, Kentucky my home. It serves as my inspiration for most of what you'll read on this blog. I hope you fall in love with this city just as much as I have.

feeds.title: Elizabethtown Lifestyle
feeds.description: Our mission at Elizabethtown Lifestyle Magazine is to connect the patrons of Elizabethtown and surrounding cities to local businesses through a curated collection of features and articles in our print publication and blog, up-to-date social media channels and through featuring and hosting community events.

feeds.title: The Styled in Blue
feeds.description: I'm Ryann, the blogger for The Styled in Blue. I write about fashion, travel, and beauty. I'm just a Kentucky girl going through life one outfit at a time. Follow along for a mix of classy pieces and trendy finds.

feeds.title: The Betty Blog
feeds.description: I'm Betty! I'm from this sweet little place named Elizabethtown, but our friends have nicknamed it Etown. I grew up in Etown and I sure do love to share my favourite spots, lifestyle ideas, weekend plans, which is exactly what you will find on the Betty Blog.

feeds.title: High Heels & Happy Hartz
feeds.description: I'm Julia, a Kentucky based fashion and lifestyle blogger. I have a love for feminine fashion, palm beach chic home decor, and miniature dachshunds. My maiden name is Hartz, and I chose the name for this blog based on that and my love for high heels.

feeds.title: Unabashedly Southern
feeds.description: A Kentucky-based southern lifestyle blog showcasing life below the Mason-Dixon Line. Authored by JC Phelps.
